reviews.x: Has all the scrunchies I've ever wanted! They are one of the only kinds of hair ties that don't get loose in my head/ make my head hurt.
Love!!! So many colors and textures of fabric....

Some of the scrunchies are not as soft as anticipated also they’re a little bit small though they actually are very durable I’ve had mine for about two years now and not one of them has broken also it comes with a variety of colors and they are all just amazing scrunchies and you can get them for a lower price then you could get five at a regular store.
Came 2 days after i ordered it ! and great wuiality for the price w nice variety

We were a few short! I wasn’t happy that I paid for 66 and was missing a few. I know things happen, but really feel like you should be more certain when you’re running a business. If you have a listing for 66 then you should definitely have 66 in the package. Also this is basically elastic with material sewn over it. I was expecting a different product overall. I guess scrunchees were made different during my time growing up though. I wasn’t upset but I wasn’t thrilled either.

These scrunchies are cheaply made and small. The elastic barely stretches in order to wrap the hair twice.  These were definitely made cheap and quality is poor.  The review are misleading and this should not be an Amazon's Choice product.  Who needs 60 scrunchies that don't even work?  Returning them.

reviews.t: More scrunchies than you will know what to do with!
reviews.x: Honestly I though surely they cannot be that great for 66 hair scrunchies for such a low price, but they have been great. I have even washed a few. The ones pictured were the ones i actually got. It was quiet the variety. Honestly it's a great buy. I don't even use all of them and its been several months. I will say that it would have gotten 5 stars if the stitching was better. Some of the scrunchies started to come undone at the seams. I still wear them as you cannot tell once its up in your ha

reviews.t: Good variety of options, not all are great quality.
reviews.x: 66 Scrunchies for $7 is a great deal. The value for the quantity is there. I liked that this pack came with scrunchies made from different fabrics so I could try them and see what I liked. It has cotton, chiffon, velvet, and satin. I thought I would be more impressed with the satin and the chiffon, but they look/feel pretty cheap. I didn't expect to like the cotton ones, but those are actually my favorite and they look nicer and better in quality.  This comes was a good variety. Fabrics, colors,

I am missing several colors (5-8) that is essential to the reason that I ordered this item. As you can see in the photo I provided, I have two of the same color meaning I am missing the red and the burgundy. Some items from the pack is double colored but I dont need those colors to be double colored , I need what was in the picture. Now I have to wait to get more and hope that it is correct this time.

I did not realize how much I prefer the velvet scrunchies but even so I did find that I did not want to mess the velvet ones up so I used the other ones for tying my hair up. The velvet ones I paired with any outfit to wear as an accessory. In terms of stretch, they are not that stretchy when you get them. You have to allow them to stretch themselves out to fit certain sizes. Rate: 9/10

These are not actual scrunchies. All they are is very tight, poor dollar store quality hair bands with material over them.  They are not gentle in my hair and they are too tight to double up around my bun. I can only do a ponytail with them.  If you only want them to make a thin ponytail these are great- otherwise they are as damaging as regular hair ties almost and they are too tight.

These scrunchies are to die for !!! SO many colors and i absolutely love the velvet and satin ones. They are also stretchy, but thick too. I only have to wrap twice and they hold my hair all day and I don’t feel like they are going to come loose at all! I’m a nurse, so this is super important to me! I also get lots of complements on them too ;)

reviews.t: these scrunches are great and worth buying .
reviews.x: [[VIDEOID:89a87146081f8e3a9d5407335ca62111]] i loved the texture of all it was packaged great some of the scrunches were a little tight but after you try them on they fit greatly also packaging was great overall it was worth the price and i got colors that i didn’t even know were there and i’m very excited to show these off !

Overall I do enjoy these scrunchies. But some were made a little too tight so I feel that once my hair is up it’s getting pulled and uncomfortable and causes headaches. Came with many tho and really handy if you’re constantly loosing your hair ties. Also great for sharing since there’s so many you can just give them away.

Great product! If you’re looking for scrunchies, look no further! Love the color and material variety and that this product offers quality and quantity without taking a toll on your pocket. Store bought scrunchies are so much more expensive and do not offer the same qualities as this product. Will buy again in the future.

These scrunches are very tight! My 7 year old daughter put some on her wrist and when she took them off ten minutes later they left marks, that’s how tight they are. I wanted to use some for myself but I can’t wear them for my convenience on my wrist with how tight they are. I wouldn’t recommend them.

Why are these so cheap? I cannot believe I got this many scrunchies for so little money. I literally have any color I’ll ever need and tons of different material. And for some reason I lose them all the time and now I have a lifetime of back ups this was the best value I’ve gotten lately.

I was surprised when this whole scrunchie trend came back around at full force.  And of course my daughter wanted me to buy some.  She loves them!  My daughter really liked the variety of this pack and the assortment of colours and print, so I bought them.

claims.text: Many reviewers praise the large variety of colors, patterns, and fabrics in the pack.
Several reviewers find the scrunchies too small and lacking stretch.
Some reviewers report receiving fewer scrunchies than the advertised 66.
Reviewers frequently describe the pack as a great value for the price and quantity.
A few reviewers mention durability concerns or quality issues like thread hanging out.
